_comment: MenuEngine dish library. Keyed lookup by name (case-insensitive, with fuzzy contains). desc = simple explanation everyone can understand. media query defaults to name; the app builds YouTube/photo search links from it.

dishes.name: Pad Krapow Gai
dishes.desc: Thai street-food classic: minced chicken stir-fried with holy basil, garlic and chili, served over rice — usually topped with a crispy fried egg.
dishes.ingredients: Minced chicken, holy basil, garlic, chili, soy & oyster sauce, rice, fried egg
steps: Stir-fry garlic-chili in hot oil until fragrant.
Add minced chicken; fry on high until cooked.
Season with soy, oyster & a little fish sauce.
Toss in holy basil off the heat.
Serve over rice with a crispy fried egg.

dishes.name: Tom Kha Gai
dishes.desc: Mild, creamy coconut soup with tender chicken, galangal, lemongrass and lime — soothing and not spicy.
dishes.ingredients: Chicken, coconut milk, galangal, lemongrass, kaffir lime, mushroom
steps: Simmer coconut milk with galangal, lemongrass & lime leaves.
Season with lime juice & a little fish sauce.

dishes.name: Tom Yum Goong
dishes.desc: Famous hot-and-sour Thai soup with shrimp, lemongrass, lime and chili — bright, zingy and aromatic. Heat is adjustable.
dishes.ingredients: Shrimp, lemongrass, galangal, lime, chili, mushroom
steps: Boil stock with lemongrass, galangal & lime leaves.
Season with lime, chili & fish sauce.

dishes.name: Som Tum
dishes.desc: Green papaya salad pounded with lime, chili, garlic, tomato and peanuts — fresh, tangy and crunchy.
dishes.ingredients: Green papaya, lime, chili, garlic, tomato, peanuts, fish sauce
steps: Pound garlic & chili in a mortar.
Add long beans & tomato; bruise lightly.
Season with lime, palm sugar & fish sauce; toss.

dishes.name: Green Curry
dishes.desc: Coconut curry with green chili paste, Thai eggplant and chicken — fragrant with basil; medium heat.
dishes.ingredients: Chicken, green curry paste, coconut milk, Thai eggplant, basil

dishes.name: Massaman Chicken
dishes.desc: Rich, mild southern-Thai curry with tender chicken, potatoes and peanuts — gently sweet and warmly spiced, not hot.
dishes.ingredients: Chicken, massaman paste, coconut milk, potato, peanuts, cinnamon
steps: Fry massaman paste in coconut cream until fragrant.
Add coconut milk, potato, onion & peanuts.
Season with tamarind, palm sugar & fish sauce.

dishes.name: Panang Curry
dishes.desc: Thick, creamy red curry that's milder and sweeter than green curry, with a deep peanut note.
dishes.ingredients: Chicken or pork, panang paste, coconut milk, kaffir lime

dishes.name: Pad Thai
dishes.desc: Stir-fried rice noodles with egg, tofu or shrimp, beansprouts and peanuts in a sweet-tangy tamarind sauce.
dishes.ingredients: Rice noodles, egg, tofu/shrimp, beansprouts, tamarind, peanuts

dishes.name: Pad See Ew
dishes.desc: Wide rice noodles stir-fried in dark soy with egg and Chinese broccoli — smoky and savory, not spicy.
dishes.ingredients: Wide rice noodles, egg, Chinese broccoli, dark soy

dishes.name: Khao Man Gai
dishes.desc: Thai-style poached chicken over rice cooked in chicken stock, with a gingery dipping sauce — clean and gentle.
dishes.ingredients: Poached chicken, rice, ginger, garlic, soybean sauce

dishes.name: Chicken Satay
dishes.desc: Grilled marinated chicken skewers with a creamy peanut dipping sauce — smoky and lightly sweet.

dishes.name: Larb
dishes.desc: Zesty minced-meat salad (chicken or pork) with lime, herbs, chili and toasted rice powder.
dishes.ingredients: Minced chicken/pork, lime, mint, chili, toasted rice

dishes.name: Khao Pad
dishes.desc: Thai fried rice with egg and vegetables — simple, comforting and quick.
dishes.ingredients: Rice, egg, onion, soy sauce, vegetables

dishes.name: Jok
dishes.desc: Thick Thai rice porridge (congee) with minced pork, ginger and a soft egg — very soft and soothing.
dishes.ingredients: Rice, minced pork, ginger, egg, scallion

dishes.name: Mango Sticky Rice
dishes.desc: Sweet sticky rice with coconut cream and ripe mango — Thailand's beloved dessert. High in sugar.
dishes.ingredients: Sticky rice, coconut milk, sugar, mango

dishes.name: Kung Pao Chicken
dishes.desc: Sichuan stir-fry of chicken with peanuts and dried chili — savory, a little sweet, with a tingly kick.
dishes.ingredients: Chicken, peanuts, dried chili, Sichuan pepper, soy

dishes.name: Mapo Tofu
dishes.desc: Soft silky tofu in a spicy, savory Sichuan sauce with a little minced pork — soft texture, bold flavor.
dishes.ingredients: Tofu, minced pork, doubanjiang, Sichuan pepper
steps: Add doubanjiang & garlic; fry till red oil.
Add stock & cubed silken tofu; simmer gently.
Thicken with a little starch slurry.

dishes.name: Sweet & Sour Pork
dishes.desc: Crispy battered pork tossed with pineapple and peppers in a tangy-sweet sauce — kid favorite.
dishes.ingredients: Pork, pineapple, bell pepper, vinegar, sugar, ketchup

dishes.name: Yangzhou Fried Rice
dishes.desc: Classic fried rice with egg, shrimp, char siu pork and peas — a meal in itself.
dishes.ingredients: Rice, egg, shrimp, char siu, peas, scallion
steps: Add cold rice; fry on high.
Add peas & egg; season with soy.

dishes.name: Char Siu
dishes.desc: Cantonese BBQ pork — glossy, sweet-savory roasted pork, sliced and served with rice.
steps: Marinate pork in hoisin, honey, soy & five-spice (4h+).

dishes.name: Pork Dumplings
dishes.desc: Juicy pork-and-chive dumplings, boiled or pan-fried — dip in soy and vinegar.

dishes.name: Hot & Sour Soup
dishes.desc: Warming soup that's both peppery and tangy, with tofu, mushroom and egg ribbons.
dishes.ingredients: Tofu, mushroom, bamboo, egg, vinegar, white pepper

dishes.name: Beef & Broccoli
dishes.desc: Tender beef and crisp broccoli in a glossy garlic-soy sauce over rice. (Contains beef.)
dishes.ingredients: Beef, broccoli, garlic, soy, oyster sauce

dishes.name: Wonton Noodle Soup
dishes.desc: Springy egg noodles and pork-shrimp wontons in a clear, comforting broth — light and soft.
dishes.ingredients: Egg noodles, pork-shrimp wontons, broth, greens

dishes.name: Century Egg Congee
dishes.desc: Silky rice porridge with preserved egg and pork — very soft, savory and easy to eat.
dishes.ingredients: Rice, century egg, pork, ginger, scallion

dishes.name: Chicken Congee
dishes.desc: Plain, soothing rice porridge simmered with chicken — gentle and very soft.

dishes.name: Garlic Stir-fried Greens
dishes.desc: Leafy greens (gai lan / choy sum) flash-fried with garlic — simple, fresh and high in fiber.

dishes.name: Braised Pork Belly
dishes.desc: Pork belly slow-braised in soy and spices until meltingly tender — soft and rich.
dishes.ingredients: Pork belly, soy, sugar, star anise, ginger

dishes.name: Youtiao
dishes.desc: Light, crispy fried dough sticks — a classic breakfast dunked into congee or soy milk.

dishes.name: Dim Sum
dishes.desc: An assortment of small steamed and fried bites — dumplings, buns and rolls — shared family-style.

dishes.name: Chicken Teriyaki
dishes.desc: Pan-glazed chicken in a glossy sweet-savory teriyaki sauce, served with rice. (Lower-sugar glaze available.)
steps: Pan-sear chicken thigh skin-side down until golden.
Add a low-sugar teriyaki glaze (soy, mirin, a little honey).

dishes.name: Yakitori
dishes.desc: Grilled chicken skewers brushed with savory tare sauce — smoky, simple, high in protein.

dishes.name: Japanese Curry Rice
dishes.desc: Thick, mild, slightly sweet curry with carrots and potato over rice — comforting and kid-friendly.
dishes.ingredients: Curry roux, carrot, potato, onion, rice

dishes.name: Miso Soup
dishes.desc: Light savory soup of fermented soybean paste with tofu, seaweed and scallion — soft and warming.

dishes.name: Tonkatsu
dishes.desc: Crispy panko-breaded pork cutlet with shredded cabbage and tangy tonkatsu sauce.
dishes.ingredients: Pork loin, panko, cabbage, tonkatsu sauce, rice
steps: Coat in flour, egg, then panko.

dishes.name: Katsudon
dishes.desc: Pork cutlet simmered with onion and egg over rice — soft, savory and comforting.
dishes.ingredients: Pork cutlet, egg, onion, dashi, rice

dishes.name: Gyoza
dishes.desc: Pan-fried pork-and-cabbage dumplings, crispy on the bottom and juicy inside.

dishes.name: Tempura
dishes.desc: Shrimp and vegetables in a light, crisp batter — delicate and airy.

dishes.name: Gyudon
dishes.desc: Thin-sliced beef simmered with onion in a sweet-savory sauce over rice. (Contains beef.)

dishes.name: Udon Noodle Soup
dishes.desc: Thick, chewy wheat noodles in a light dashi broth — soft, warm and easy to eat.
dishes.ingredients: Udon noodles, dashi, scallion, tempura bits

dishes.name: Ramen
dishes.desc: Wheat noodles in a rich broth with toppings like pork, egg and scallion — hearty and slurpable.
dishes.ingredients: Ramen noodles, broth, pork, egg, scallion

dishes.name: Onigiri
dishes.desc: Rice balls wrapped in seaweed with a savory filling — handy, mild and portable.

dishes.name: Okonomiyaki
dishes.desc: Savory cabbage pancake topped with sauce, mayo and bonito flakes — fun and filling.
dishes.ingredients: Cabbage, batter, pork, okonomi sauce, bonito

dishes.name: Sushi & Maki
dishes.desc: Vinegared rice with fish or vegetables, as nigiri or rolls. (Contains raw fish unless cooked/veg rolls.)

dishes.name: Seaweed Salad
dishes.desc: Chilled marinated seaweed — light, slightly sweet and full of minerals.

dishes.name: Roast Chicken
dishes.desc: Whole chicken roasted with herbs until juicy — lean protein the whole family can share.
steps: Pat chicken dry; rub with herbs, garlic, salt.
Roast at 200°C until juices run clear.

dishes.name: Mac & Cheese
dishes.desc: Macaroni baked in a creamy three-cheese sauce — soft, rich and kid-approved.

dishes.name: Grilled Cheese & Tomato Soup
dishes.desc: Toasted cheese sandwich with a warm, smooth tomato soup — classic soft comfort food.

dishes.name: Cobb Salad
dishes.desc: Hearty salad with chicken, egg, avocado and greens — high in protein and fiber.

dishes.name: Caesar Salad

dishes.name: BBQ Ribs

dishes.ingredients: Pork ribs, BBQ sauce, spice rub

dishes.name: Fried Chicken

dishes.ingredients: Pork shoulder, BBQ sauce, bun, slaw

dishes.name: Cheeseburger

dishes.ingredients: Beef patty, cheese, bun, lettuce, tomato

dishes.name: Pizza
dishes.desc: Baked flatbread with tomato sauce, cheese and toppings — a crowd-pleaser.

dishes.name: Pancakes
dishes.desc: Fluffy breakfast pancakes served with fruit and syrup.

dishes.name: Oatmeal & Fruit

dishes.name: Scrambled Eggs
dishes.desc: Soft scrambled eggs — quick protein for breakfast.

dishes.name: Soft-boiled Eggs

dishes.name: Boiled Eggs
dishes.desc: Hard-boiled eggs — easy, portable protein.

dishes.name: Edamame
dishes.desc: Steamed young soybeans with a little salt — plant protein and fiber.

dishes.name: Fresh Fruit
dishes.desc: A platter of seasonal fresh fruit — a light, naturally sweet finish.

dishes.name: Multigrain Toast
dishes.desc: Wholegrain toast — fiber-rich base for breakfast.

dishes.name: Soy Milk

dishes.name: Goma-ae Spinach

steps: Mix with soy & a little sugar.
Toss spinach in the sesame dressing.

dishes.name: Sunomono
dishes.desc: Chilled cucumber salad in a light sweet-sour vinegar — crisp and refreshing.

dishes.name: Kinpira Gobo

dishes.name: Hiyayakko

dishes.name: Steamed Ginger-Scallion Chicken
dishes.desc: Gently steamed chicken with a fragrant ginger-scallion oil — lean, tender and very soft.
steps: Rub chicken with a little salt & wine.
Steam over high heat until just cooked.
Heat oil; pour over ginger & scallion.

dishes.name: Winter Melon Soup
dishes.desc: Light, clear soup with silky winter melon — soothing and low-calorie.
dishes.ingredients: Winter melon, chicken stock, goji, scallion

dishes.name: Pickled Mustard Greens

dishes.name: Soy-braised Chicken
dishes.desc: Chicken simmered in soy, ginger and star anise until glossy and tender.
dishes.ingredients: Chicken, soy, ginger, star anise, sugar
steps: Add soy, ginger, star anise, sugar & water.

dishes.name: Khao Tom
dishes.desc: Light Thai rice soup with pork or chicken and ginger — clean, soft and easy to digest.

dishes.name: Stir-fried Morning Glory
dishes.desc: Crunchy water spinach flashed with garlic and a little chili — quick, fresh and high in fiber.
dishes.ingredients: Water spinach, garlic, chili, soybean sauce

dishes.name: Stir-fried Long Beans
dishes.desc: Snappy long beans stir-fried with garlic — simple green fiber on the side.

dishes.name: Roasted Vegetable Medley
dishes.desc: Carrots, broccoli and cauliflower roasted until sweet and caramelized — colorful fiber.

dishes.name: Garden Salad
dishes.desc: Crisp mixed greens, tomato and cucumber in a light vinaigrette — fresh and bright.

dishes.name: Steamed Pumpkin
dishes.desc: Soft steamed pumpkin — naturally sweet, gentle and rich in fiber.

dishes.name: Greek Yogurt & Fruit
dishes.desc: Thick yogurt with fresh fruit and a little honey — protein and probiotics to start the day.
